How a Game works

Briefs, submissions and results are all in the Telegram or VK bot. Each Game has its own number of rounds and final format.

  1. 01
    Sign-up

    Fill in a short form and accept the Rules in the Telegram or VK bot. Takes a couple of minutes.

  2. 02
    Round one

    One brief for everyone. It sets your league and starting rating.

  3. 03
    Rounds in your league

    The brief arrives in the bot. You send a photo of your work to the bot before the deadline, post it on your own VK or Instagram* page and send the post link.

  4. 04
    Judging

    Several judges. After each round: your result, TOP WORK marks and rating change.

  5. 05
    Game results

    Medals and prizes for 1st–3rd place in each league; a certificate and FPL Points for everyone who finishes.

How works are judged

Several judges, with a scoring method for each round type. How each round is judged is set out in the Game Rules.

  1. AnonymousJudges score works without the authors' names.
  2. Head-to-head and by criteriaIn some rounds judges compare works in pairs; in others they score by criteria: originality, composition, technique.
  3. Opponent-awareYour FPL Rating grows more when you beat a strong work.
  4. VerifiedAI and distorting edits are banned. If in doubt, we ask for photos of the work in progress.
How rounds are judged — see the Rules

Frequently asked questions

Can beginners join?

Yes. After round one you compete in your own league, with artists at a similar level.

Do I have to play every Game of the season?

No. You can join the season at any Game. But to reach the Super Final through the season standings, you need to play several Games.

How do I get into the Super Final?

Take 1st–3rd place in Gold or 1st place in Silver in any Game. Or through the season standings: 2 of 3 Games in Gold, or all 3 Games in Silver or Gold.

How much does it cost?

The first Game is free for every new participant. The entry fee for later Games is published before they start.

What if I miss the deadline?

A late work does not enter the competition, and the Game does not count toward the season. You can carry on out of competition: if you submit all works by the end of the Game, you still get the certificate.

Do I need a model?

Not always. It depends on the brief; child models are allowed.

Can I join from another country?

Yes. The League is online, so you can join from any country.

How is the ban on AI and heavy editing enforced?

AI and distorting edits are banned. If needed, we may ask for photos or video of the work in progress.

Where does the League take place?

Online. Briefs and submissions go through the Telegram or VK bot.
